crossRefs.note: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom…
He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things…
Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying…
how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these…
Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,
Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying…
Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning…
He said to them, “This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of…
A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being…
Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
translations.bsb: So they set a day to meet with Paul, and many people came to the place he was staying. He expounded to them from morning to evening, testifying about the kingdom of God and persuading them about Jesus from the Law of Moses and the Prophets.
translations.kjv: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
translations.asv: And when they had appointed him a day, they came to him into his lodging in great number; to whom he expounded the matter, testifying the kingdom of God, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning till evening.
